steps.heading: Real dates, not text
steps.body: to_datetime() converts strings into actual datetime64 values. Only then does the .dt accessor (year, month, day_name...) and chronological comparison work correctly, text that merely looks like a date doesn't behave like one.

steps.heading: Pulling out components
steps.caption: The .dt accessor mirrors .str for text, it's the gateway to every date component.

steps.heading: Dates as the index
steps.body: set_index() on a date column produces a DatetimeIndex, which unlocks partial-string slicing (loc['2024-01-05':'2024-01-07']) and is required by resample() for bucketing into weeks, months, etc.

steps.heading: Weekly totals
steps.caption: You'll practice dt components, date_range, Timedelta, between(), and resample() in the cards that follow.
